messages.github.connection.outbound: Check the current GitHub account in Connections. The capability catalog shows what agents can use.
messages.github.connection.summary: Connect your account on this computer. Feed reads unread notifications, and you can check the account in Connections.
messages.github.guide.oauth-note: The app supports Device Flow. Set up your own OAuth App Client ID before first use.
messages.github.guide.token-note: Create a PAT with notifications and read:user access, then paste it here.
